## Activity

During January 2022, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 43 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and establishes the number of images available for review. The recorded activity should be considered alongside the image-quality findings and grading outcomes below.

## Image quality

Of the 43 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.0 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered when reviewing the overall performance of the service. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 16 days. This result should be reviewed with the service’s activity and image-quality information to support ongoing monitoring. The site should continue to record operational issues consistently, including any recurring camera problems, and ensure that these are referred to the service desk for follow-up.
